properties.statement:
Rung 3 of reflow2:dec:the-proof-ladder-goes-on-with-four-colour-then-the-rocket-equation-then-gettier. Observer: the coordinating session. Reference: scratchpad gt-trial/OBSERVER.md. Packet: Gettier 1963 (primary, full sha256) and the SEP "The Analysis of Knowledge" (rev. 2026-01-21). The observer reran reasoning_report on (a).

PASS:
(1) ONE DIRECTION ONLY. (a) is split into req:jtb-sufficient and req:jtb-necessary, joined by biconditional introduction. req:jtb-not-sufficient CONTRADICTS the sufficiency half and (a), never necessity. Observer's read: (a) reads "refuted — refuted by req:jtb-not-sufficient, which holds", and necessity reads "open".
(2) Gettier's two points are separate premises. Each case has its own verdict ("judgement", read shown) and stipulations.
(3) The barn case reads CONTESTED through req:obj-sosa-henry-knows (S2 §10.2). No-false-lemmas is refuted by the robot dog (details RECALLED, flagged). Sensitivity is met by Kripke, and safety and K-reliabilism read open (no packet counterexample).
(4) Zagzebski's class argument is recorded with generalizes_over X plus one instance per repair, each with a membership premise. It shares the fallibility premise with Gettier.
(5) "Knowledge is analysable" is one premise that (a) and all four repairs rest on. Knowledge-first and the no-progress argument contradict it.
(6) Historical claims (Plato, "a convenient fiction", Dharmottara, the barn's origin, few endorsing sensitivity) are evidence records linked to no epistemic claim.
(7) The open question is a proposed Decision, with the contested setting asked of the owner.

FINDINGS FOR REFLOW2 (the independence one was confirmed in the observer's own read):
(a) THE INDEPENDENCE CHECK COMPARES STEPS, NOT PREMISES, NOW IN A THIRD TRIAL. On inf:not-sufficient-via-case-2 against case-1 it returned {"holds":true,"shared_steps":[],"why":"the two lines share no step … are independent"}, though both rest on req:g-fallibility and req:g-closure. This is the same class as the NS map (b) and the four colour finding (e). The NS map's version is now reproduced.
(b) A WHAT-IF PAST A CONTESTED ROUTE READS "UNSUPPORTED". Dropping closure leaves jtb-not-sufficient with conclusion_reads "unsupported" while untouched_routes names the contested barn route. It should read contested.
(c) objections_returning reverses direction: it lists the TARGETS (jtb-analysis, jtb-sufficient) as objections "answered_by" jtb-not-sufficient.
(d) A DEPENDS_ON premise gives reach but no falls/stands reading. A what-if on the shared "knowledge is analysable" premise shows the 5 analyses at distance 1, with no inference rows.
(e) NO RECORD FOR "EVERY INSTANCE OF A PATTERN". generalizes_over plus per-instance membership premises was the workaround.
(f) RECALLED material has no marker. A recalled case reads as a stated foundation and refutes like a quoted one.
(g) Changing a premise's role (assumed to plain) took 4 delete_edge calls. add_inference cannot change an existing premise's role.
(h) Known, again:
- software gaps on an "argument" design;
- a conjecture reads truth "not delivered, status proposed";
- detect_gaps calls a governing Decision with 6 GOVERNED_BY edges "connects to nothing";
- detect_defects reads a historical ANTICIPATES as an undelivered setup;
- the add_requirement and add_inference schemas are stale (statement kinds, `immediate`);
- the view_note says `member`.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
